en.headline: This week: steamed, not fried
body: Pick steamed fish over fried fish this week.
en.passage: Choose steamed, boiled or grilled dishes, such as steamed fish instead of fried fish.

ms.headline: Minggu ini: kukus, bukan goreng
body: Pilih ikan kukus, bukan ikan goreng minggu ini.
ms.passage: Choose steamed, boiled or grilled dishes, such as steamed fish instead of fried fish.

zh.headline: 这周：蒸的，不要炸的
body: 油炸食物会让胆固醇升高。
zh.passage: Choose steamed, boiled or grilled dishes, such as steamed fish instead of fried fish.
